{{Quote|In all the galaxy, there is no greater force than true love. Love sustains, nourishes and protects. Without love, the galaxy would be cold and empty. Your bond lends fire to the stars, dissolving the darkness.<br />Do you take this man as your husband, to cherish for the rest of your days?<br />Do you take this woman as your wife, to honor in word and deed?<br />May your love transcend time, distance and all barriers between. The Terms of Bonding are complete. You may now kiss.|CGR-80 recites the Terms of Bonding|<ref name="Modest">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Doc|A Modest Proposal}}</ref>}}
The '''Terms of Bonding''' was a [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] ceremony utilized around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. While holding hands, the groom and bride were asked in succession if they accepted their partner as their spouse. [[Ceremony, Gala, and Ritual droid]]s such as [[CGR-80]] were programmed with the Terms and were capable of performing marriages by presiding over the ceremony.<ref name="Modest" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Terms of Bonding first appear in the conversation "A Modest Proposal" with [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]], a companion character for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. If female Knights accept Doc's proposal of marriage, he will summon CGR-80 and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] will marry him and the player.<ref name="Modest" />
